name: Intel Arc A750 Graphics ARK product specifications (SKU 227954)
notes: First-party ARK table for the desktop A750, SKU 227954, device ID 0x56A1. Quoted rows: Code Name Products formerly Alchemist, Microarchitecture Xe HPG, Lithography Type TSMC N6, Vertical Segment Desktop, Launch Date Q3 2022, 28 Xe-cores, 448 Xe Vector Engines, 448 XMX engines, Graphics Clock 2050 MHz, GPU Peak TOPS (Int8) 229, TBP 225 W, PCI Express up to 4.0 x16, Memory Size 8 GB, Memory Type GDDR6, Graphics Memory Interface 256 bit, Graphics Memory Bandwidth 512 GB/s, Graphics Memory Speed 16 Gbps. 16 Gbps times 256-bit divided by 8 equals 512 GB/s, so the bandwidth row agrees with the speed and bus rows. No FP16, BF16 or FP8 throughput is printed.
